topic: SD Order-to-Cash: new pricing procedure for government contracts
description: Pricing determination for government-contract sales orders changes from a manually-applied discount condition (ECC6) to an automatic condition record lookup (S/4HANA) based on contract tier. Users no longer key in discounts manually; they select the correct contract tier and the system derives price.
target_audience: Order Management Officers (end users, no prior S/4HANA exposure)
prior_knowledge: Familiar with ECC6 VA01/VA02 order entry; no exposure to S/4HANA Fiori apps
learning_level: apply (hands-on task completion), per Bloom's taxonomy
must_cover: Where contract tier is selected on the sales order
How to verify the system-derived price is correct
Error handling: what to do when no condition record is found
What NOT to do: manually overriding price like in ECC6
